C-53.Name: Release materials for 2.3.1: What's New sheet, README, CHANGELOG, screenshots — and a materials step in the release procedure
C-53.Summary: User 2026-10-17 before tagging 2.3.1: «почему в гейте нет тотального обновления материалов, визуалов, ридми?» and «почему не обсуждали What's New — там большая часть со старой версии, ещё до гэп-анализа». The in-app What's New for 2.3.1 was written on 2026-10-15 (one item now false: «Hover and press ⤢»), the README describes 2.3.0 with 2.3.0 screenshots, CHANGELOG stops at 2.3.0. Content is ranked by the MarkView gap categories (user: «от гэпа»): UI polish, product mechanics, content rendering, folder work, AI/agents, breadth.

Problem.Description: The release procedure checks versions, tests, tag and latest.json, but never that user-facing materials match the release.

Goals.R-1: What's New 2.3.1 sheet: the four user-approved items (EN/RU texts in D-1) in all 10 locales, plus an «Also» line and a «See everything new» link to the GitHub release page.
Goals.R-2: README «What's new in 2.3.1» in the six gap categories (D-2), stale claims fixed (⌘D compares with Mark's snapshots; theme count as families), screenshots re-shot from the current app by a reproducible Playwright capture (Paper theme, new sidebar, themed diagrams, fullscreen viewer, home screen).
Goals.R-3: CHANGELOG.md 2.3.1 entry in the same six categories.
Goals.R-4: AGENTS.md release procedure gains a mandatory «materials» step: What's New sheet, README What's new + screenshots, CHANGELOG, release notes — all checked against the shipped change specs before tagging.

Constraints.Item: Approved texts are used verbatim for EN and RU; other locales are real translations of them.

NonGoals.Item: Website (C-35) and App Store listing (C-23) stay separate changes.

AffectedAreas.Item: src/renderer/src/whatsNew/data.js, components/whatsNew, static/locales/*.json, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/assets/readme/*, a capture spec under tests/e2e, AGENTS.md.

VerificationIntent.Item: Unit tests for the What's New content (4 items, also line, link) and every locale; the capture spec runs on demand; full gates green.

Decisions.D-1: 2026-10-17 user «гуд» on the sheet: 1 «A calmer, native-looking Mark» / «Спокойнее и роднее для системы» — New Paper, Ink, Docs and macOS themes, a slim title bar and an outline beside the page. / Темы Paper, Ink, Docs и macOS, лёгкий заголовок и оглавление рядом с текстом. 2 «A home screen» / «Стартовый экран» — Recent files and folders, the Guide, and one click to connect your agent. / Недавние файлы и папки, Guide и подключение агента в один клик. 3 «Diagrams that match the theme» / «Диаграммы в цвет темы» — Mermaid, charts and math take the theme's colours; open any of them full screen. / Mermaid, графики и формулы в цветах темы; любую можно открыть на весь экран. 4 «Only your notes» / «Только заметки» — Folders show Markdown files only, with Recent and Pinned on top. / В папке только Markdown, недавние и закреплённые — сверху. Also: «⌘D shows what your agent changed · ⌥⌘V opens a copied folder · one zoom for everything» / «⌘D — правки агента · ⌥⌘V — открыть скопированную папку · один зум на всё».
Decisions.D-2: 2026-10-17 user «гуд» on the ranking: categories in this order — 1 UI polish (themes Paper/Ink/Docs/macOS, slim title bar + document card, outline, status bar, system font/accent/icons, Mica on Windows, 5-tab Settings in the theme colour); 2 product mechanics (home screen with recent files/folders and Connect your agent, the Guide, What's New after updates, App Store rating request, language «As in system»); 3 content rendering (all 22 Mermaid types, Vega and math in theme colours, Keynote donut, fullscreen diagrams and tables, wide tables scroll, column resize, Vega fixed in the installed app); 4 working with a folder (Markdown-only tree without empty folders, Recent and Pinned, open a folder from the clipboard ⌥⌘V or by dropping it); 5 AI and agents (⌘D shows the agent's edits from Mark's snapshots, the agent prompt lists everything Mark renders); 6 breadth (one zoom, code line numbers back, Share in the App Store build).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-4 done; grace lint 0; full unit + e2e green.
